issues: Scrambled/merged list markers in multiple places (e.g., Article 11 'and/orc.', Article 12 '...; f.' and '...;andh.', Article 13 'andd.', Article 15 'andc.', Article 16 '...; d.' and 'ande.', Article 19 'duty to:a.' and 'andh.', and 'consisting of:a.' and 'andd.') causing list structure to not match the original.

Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 23: item e is attached to item d

Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 27(2)-(3): multiple lettered items are run together on one line; item d is attached to item c ("dand.")
Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 28(2): multiple lettered items are run together on one line
Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 29(2): item c is attached to "and" ("danc.")
